targetQuery: N/A — /demo is a per-prospect sales preview, not an organic target. It is noindex, follow:false, nocache:true and is deliberately excluded from the sitemap. It exists only to show a named prospect a working, branded instance of a calculator after they receive outreach email.
evidenceSource: N/A — no keyword research applies. This page does not compete for rankings and carries no ad or affiliate inventory. The commercial rationale was validated separately: agencies quote $13,000-25,000 for bespoke financial calculators while freelance marketplaces list unbranded single calculators at $100-500, leaving the $500-2,500 branded-suite price point uncontested.

serpIntent: N/A — no SERP intent to match. The page is reached only from a cold outreach link, so its only job is to make a stranger click the calculator, change a number, and believe the product is real within five seconds.
competitorWeakness: N/A for SERP. Commercially, cold outreach in this segment universally promises a build rather than demonstrating one. A working branded sample removes the prospect's need to imagine the outcome, which is the specific weakness this page exploits.
pageTypeDecision: Dynamic app route at /demo reading ?co= and ?ref= query params — a client-demo surface, not a calculator index page, blog post, guide, or comparison.
